label: Levied by
note: The county bills and collects both county and school taxes; the school share (about 81% of a New Castle County bill) goes to the State Treasurer for the school district.
source_title: New Castle County, Delaware: Property Reassessment and Tax Billing FAQ (updated 12/9/25)

label: State realty transfer tax (where the full local tax applies)
note: 2.5% state tax when the county or municipality levies the full 1.5% local tax (about 4% in total). Split equally between buyer and seller.
source_title: Delaware Code Title 30, Chapter 54, Subchapter I: Realty Transfer Tax (§ 5402)

label: State realty transfer tax (no local tax)
note: Taxes on the transfer of real estate. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Delaware Division of Revenue: First-Time Home Buyer Tax Credit

label: Local realty transfer tax (county or municipality)
note: Counties and municipalities may levy up to 1.5% under 9 Del. C. § 8102 and 22 Del. C. § 1601.
source_title: Delaware Code Title 30, Chapter 54, Subchapter I: Realty Transfer Tax (§ 5402)

label: Who pays
value: Shared equally by grantor (seller) and grantee (buyer)
note: Absent an agreement otherwise, the grantor bears the tax as between the parties.
source_title: Delaware Code Title 30, Chapter 54, Subchapter I: Realty Transfer Tax (§ 5402)

label: First-time home buyer reduction
value: Buyer's share cut by 0.5% of value up to $400,000 (maximum $2,000)
note: Typically lowers the buyer's state share from 1.25% to 0.75%; the seller's share is unchanged.
source_title: Delaware Code Title 30, Chapter 54, Subchapter I: Realty Transfer Tax (§ 5402)
